# Vero

> Vero is the gamified budgeting app for Gen Z. Log spending in seconds without open banking, plan your month and earn real rewards with Verdi.

Vero is a mobile app for iOS and Android, made by Vero Financial Ltd. It does not connect to or access your bank account. Vero is free to use, with an optional Vero Plus plan for £4.99 a month.

## Product

- [Home](https://verofin.uk/): What Vero does, how it works, and answers to common questions about data safety, tokens and rewards
- [How Vero works](https://verofin.uk/#how-it-works): Know what's safe to spend every day, log spending your way in seconds, and turn good habits into tokens you spend on Verdi's trips for real rewards
- [Pricing](https://verofin.uk/#pricing): Vero Free and Vero Plus at a glance
- [Plans](https://verofin.uk/plans): Compare Vero Free and Vero Plus. Start free, then upgrade for automated logging, deeper insights and more challenges
- [Meet Verdi](https://verofin.uk/verdi-companion): Verdi is a little elephant who grows as your money habits do. Earn tokens, fund his trips and collect rewards

## Budget management

- [Budget management in Vero](https://verofin.uk/budget-management): How accounts, pockets, groups, goals, plans, bills and sharing fit together, and how they add up to a safe-to-spend number
- [Accounts and safe to spend](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/accounts): Add your real accounts with a rough balance, no bank login; safe to spend is money with no job yet, minus bills still due that their own pocket can't cover
- [Pockets](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/pockets): Named pots for a purpose (rent, family, fun), filled with Move money, which is neither spending nor income
- [Groups](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/groups): Optional folders for pockets, with a total for each
- [Goals](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/goals): Pockets with a target and an optional date, a single pace line, and amber (never red) when behind
- [Plans](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/plans): A month, week or custom period with spending caps on categories, pockets or groups, a save side for goals, and bills
- [Bills and IOUs](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/bills-and-ious): What you pay and what you're owed, as a calendar or list, with IOUs you can share by link
- [Sharing](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/sharing): Share a pocket or group with someone who can view or can add spending; only the owner changes what pockets hold
- [Manage and Dashboard](https://verofin.uk/budget-management/manage-and-dashboard): Manage lists everything you've set up; Dashboard is tabs of blocks you build yourself

- [All guides](https://verofin.uk/guides): Plain-English budgeting guides and fair app comparisons from the Vero team
- [Compare apps](https://verofin.uk/compare): Every comparison and round-up in one place

- [How to budget on your first salary](https://verofin.uk/how-to-budget-on-your-first-salary): A step-by-step UK guide for 2026/27
- [Cleo alternative: Vero vs Cleo](https://verofin.uk/vs/cleo): What Cleo does well, and how Vero builds a spending habit without a bank connection
- [Emma alternative: Vero vs Emma](https://verofin.uk/vs/emma): An automatic open banking overview against a daily habit with no bank link, and how to use both
- [How to budget with Monzo Pots](https://verofin.uk/how-to-budget-with-monzo-pots): A simple Pots setup for bills, savings and spending, Salary Sorter, and what's free versus paid
- [Goodbudget alternative: Vero vs Goodbudget](https://verofin.uk/vs/goodbudget): Envelope budgeting typed in by hand against quick logging with no bank link, priced in pounds
- [Snoop alternative: Vero vs Snoop](https://verofin.uk/vs/snoop): Cutting bills from your bank feed against changing everyday spending with no bank link, and using both
- [Fortune City alternative: Vero vs Fortune City](https://verofin.uk/vs/fortune-city): Two gamified money apps; in-game city rewards against real-world discounts
- [YNAB alternatives: Vero vs YNAB](https://verofin.uk/vs/ynab): YNAB's zero-based method against Vero's lighter plans, plus other UK alternatives priced in pounds
